prompts.prompt:
[FORMAT]
Vertical 2:3 Pinterest pin composition.

[SUBJECT]
A close-cropped lifestyle scene on a raw oak wood desk bathed in morning window light: a human hand with natural unmanicured nails making a check mark in an open planner with a fine-tip pen, a ceramic latte mug with a latte art leaf casting a soft steam wisp, and a small terracotta pot holding a delicate clover plant with three-leaf clusters, all arranged in an intimate, lived-in vignette.

[COMPOSITION]
Vertical 2:3 framing with a strong top-to-bottom visual hierarchy. The planner and checking hand anchor the upper-center third, drawing the eye downward to the latte mug at mid-frame and the clover pot nestled at the lower third. 85mm portrait lens at f/2.8 renders the background in a soft graduated bokeh while keeping the hand, pen tip, and mug rim in crisp focus. Slight 30° overhead angle — not fully top-down — to reveal the latte surface and planner pages simultaneously. Intentional breathing room between objects, never crowded. Hand-crafted, not stock.

[AESTHETIC]
Pinterest-native clean-girl meets study-gram: warm, quiet, aspirational morning ritual. Lived-in productivity — the feeling of a slow, intentional morning before the day begins. Cottagecore-adjacent but grounded and contemporary. No performative staging.

[LIGHTING]
Soft directional 5500K morning daylight streaming through a sheer linen curtain from camera-right, producing gentle dappled foliage shadow across the planner pages and desk surface. Large softbox diffusion quality — wrapping, never harsh. Secondary bounced fill from camera-left at 4800K ambient skylight to open shadows without flattening depth. Gentle highlight rolloff on the ceramic mug glaze and the hand's skin. Steam from the latte catches the backlight as a translucent wisp. Overall color temperature 4500K mixed window-and-ambient.

[SURFACE & TEXTURE]
Raw oak wood grain desk surface with visible grain lines and a faint worn finish. Open planner with cream-white dot-grid pages showing hand-drawn check boxes and light pencil marks — no legible text or words, only gestural marks. Latte served in a hand-thrown ceramic mug with a matte oat-white glaze and subtle finger-thrown ridges. Small terracotta pot with visible earthenware texture. Woven jute coaster under the mug. Tactile, lived-in finish throughout — never sterile or plastic.

[COLOR PALETTE]
Muted Pinterest earthy-neutral palette: dominant cream and oat white from planner pages and mug, warm terracotta from the plant pot echoed in the wood grain, soft sage green from the clover leaves, and a whisper of dusty rose in the ambient shadow tones. Desaturated, film-adjacent color grading with lifted shadows and slightly pulled highlights.

[STYLE REFERENCE]
In the style of Beth Kirby, Brittany Ambridge, and Pia Ulin. Editorial Pinterest aesthetic — warm, intimate, save-worthy morning lifestyle photography.

[QUALITY MARKERS]
Save-worthy, scroll-stopping, magazine-quality, hyper-detailed textures, photorealistic. Grain-kissed film aesthetic with fine 35mm texture overlay. No AI sheen on skin or ceramic surfaces.

[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image,
no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering,
no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects,
no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look,
no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash,
no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions,
no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures,
no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look,
no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones,
no AI uncanny faces, no warped facial geometry, no plastic skin,
no stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look,
no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments,
no clipart elements, no obviously composited backgrounds,
no oversaturated colors, no neon, no Instagram-grid square framing,
no horizontal-leaning compositions, no sterile feel,
no legible text, no letters, no words, no numbers, no typography of any kind anywhere in the image, no readable marks on planner pages.

resolution: 2k
